amendment_policy: append-only; corrections must be recorded in SOURCE_INCREMENT_EXPERIMENT.md section '偏离预注册'
frozen_by: DATA-EXPANSION-001 lead, before any experiment number existed

rules.anchor_rule: per firm, per calendar year 2017-2024, first openFDA 510(k)/PMA decision by (decision_date, official number)
rules.exp_a_decision: INCREMENTAL iff coverage_any >= 0.10 and duplicate_rate <= 0.50; INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE below 20 real records
rules.exp_b_scope: no population precision/recall/F1; only error rate on the authoritative-identifier subset, refusal rate, candidate volume, decoy control
rules.exp_c_decision: detectable lead iff T1 median lead vs placebo one-sided permutation p < 0.05 AND confirmed_link_rate >= 0.7
rules.lead_time_quality_gate: only source_public_at_quality in {exact, day} may enter lead-time statistics
